body: Cedar FC striker Alex Reed tore his hamstring in training on Tuesday. The club confirmed he will miss six weeks. Coach Morgan said the medical team would reassess him next month.
Cedar FC have signed striker Alex Reed from Maple United on a four-year contract. Both clubs confirmed the transfer on Tuesday. Reed will join the squad tomorrow.
Cedar FC have appointed Morgan Lane as head coach on a three-year contract. Lane replaces Sam Park, who was dismissed on Monday. The club announced the coaching change today.
Cedar FC supporters celebrated their cup victory with tears of joy. Captain Alex Reed said: I am overwhelmed and delighted. We were terrified we would lose, but now we feel such relief.
Cedar FC will play Maple United on Saturday at 3pm at Cedar Stadium. Tickets cost 25 pounds and can be purchased at the ticket office. Gates open at 1pm.
Maple United striker Robin Wood tore his hamstring and will miss six weeks. Maple United confirmed the injury today. This report contains no information about Cedar FC.
Maple United supporters were delighted with their victory. Robin Wood said he felt relieved and proud. This report contains no news about Cedar FC.
Maple United have sacked head coach Robin Wood and appointed Pat Green. The report contains no news about Cedar FC.
Cedar FC striker Alex Reed is out for six weeks with a hamstring injury. Cedar FC face Maple United next Saturday. No Maple United player is injured or suspended.
Cedar FC denied reports that Alex Reed is leaving. The sporting director said there are no transfer talks, no offer and no planned departure. Reed remains at Cedar FC.
